newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson Multimedia to launch DVD players in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Multimedia to launch DVD players in Europe.

text.p: Thomson Multimedia, the consumer electronics arm of Thomson SA, said it would launch the first digital video disc (DVD) players in Europe in March.
It said the market for these players would be two million consumers by the year 2000.
The players will be sold in France for 5,000 francs ($893).

A DVD brings the digital quality of Compact Discs to pictures, improving on video tape, and has a bigger storage capacity which would allow subtitling or dubbing in various languages on the same disc. ($ = 5.597 French Francs)
